version: v3.4 (2026-10-02 PT): casting is a free action (no question, no fizzle)

rules.price_unit: G(t) = gold per normal enemy at the selling town = 3 x L_rec(t)
rules.damage: max(1, round(power x (Tired ? 1.5 : 1) - DEF_e)); fixed power (no ATK/gear/level scaling), full enemy DEF, no streak or spoken bonus
rules.design_rule: power = round(F x HP_normal(t) + DEF(t)); mp = round(K x MP_pool(t)), MP_pool = 10 + 2 x L_rec(t)
rules.cast: free action: uses the hero turn, asks no question, cannot fizzle; MP is always spent; no MP regen and no streak change on that turn
rules.cast_rule_text: max 1 cast per normal or elite battle, 2 per boss battle (the 2nd at least 12 questions after the 1st); the Spellbook unlocks only after 3 correct answers in that battle
rules.ownership: permanent; castable in any battle when MP >= cost and the cast rule allows
rules.magic_ward: dropped in v3.4 (was x0.5 spell damage in boss battles in v3.3)
rules.mp_potions_note: map only (never in battle), so a potion never replaces a question turn
rules.blacksmith_first: the magic shop reminds the kid when a purchase would leave less gold than the next town's weapon + armor + shield
rules.same_turn: a spell replaces the attack; it never combines with Frost/Sweep on the same turn; companion team attack is unchanged

spells.status: Soaked: the target's next attack does half damage

Fluffy snowballs pop out of the air and pelt every enemy of the chosen kind; soft white bursts and a sprinkle of snowflakes. Enemies shiver comically.
